# KafkaQuorumCommitSlow

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-kraft](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-kraft/) | 10m / 1m |

**Summary:** KRaft metadata commits on node <kafka_broker> take more than 1 s

Committing metadata records to a majority of voters is slow. Leader elections and topic changes are delayed; check the controller nodes' disks and network.

## Impact

Metadata changes (leader elections, ISR updates, topic creation) take seconds.

## Diagnosis

1. Disk latency of the metadata log on the voters (log flush latency, I/O PSI) and network between voters.

## Mitigation

- Faster disks for controllers, fewer concurrent metadata operations (e.g. batch topic creation).

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster, kafka_broker) (kafka_server_raftmetrics_commit_latency_avg) > 1000
```
